Command `python3 -c "
import struct, sys

# Craft a minimal OpenPGP Literal Data packet (tag 11)
# Old format header: 1 0 TTTT LL where TTTT=1011 (tag 11), LL=00 (1-byte length)
# = 0b10101100 = 0xAC

# Body: mode(1) + namelen(1) + name(namelen) + timestamp(4) + data
# mode = 'b' (binary) = 0x62
# namelen = 0
# timestamp = 0x00000000
# data = empty

body = b'\x62\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00'
header = bytes([0xAC, len(body)])
packet = header + body

with open('/workspace/poc.gpg', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(packet)

print(f'Written {len(packet)} bytes')
print('Hex:', packet.hex())
"` executed with exit code 0.
